🛂 Let me start with the bit that does NOT suit my argument, because you deserve straight dealing.

Asylum claims FELL 21% in the year to June 2026, to 85,891. The backlog fell 56% to its lowest since 2019. That is a fall, and I am not going to pretend it is a rise.

But here is the figure nobody put in a press release 👇

📌 41% of asylum claimants — 34,999 people — ALREADY HELD A UK VISA or other leave
📌 Small boat claimants: 33,949

More people claimed asylum after coming through the visa system than came across the Channel.

And it is getting worse in one place: claims from former WORK visa holders are up 16%, driven largely by a more than DOUBLING in claims from Graduate visa holders.

That is not a failure of enforcement at the beach. That is a failure of design in Whitehall.

Meanwhile the Home Office is making more than FOUR TIMES the number of initial decisions it averaged between 2010 and 2019 — and refusing 73,478 of them.

The border is not just the water. 🇬🇧
